model: Maltiti A. Enterprise Ecosystem Knowledge Model
warning: Derived from the canonical model. Not editable here. Every node carries a truth status — read it before trusting it.

statusDefinition.CONFIRMED: Verified against at least one independent, attributable source of adequate reliability, or directly observed. The claim can be repeated to an external party.
statusDefinition.PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED: The existence or broad shape of the thing is supported by a source, but material detail (scale, ownership, location, current status) is not.
statusDefinition.INFERRED: Not stated by any source. Derived by reasoning from other model content or from domain knowledge. Must always name the inference basis in 'notes'.
statusDefinition.UNVERIFIED: Asserted by a source of unknown or low reliability, or asserted without corroboration and not yet checked.
statusDefinition.UNKNOWN: The model knows that this thing or property exists as a question but holds no value for it. Used to make an absence explicit rather than invisible.
statusDefinition.HISTORICAL: Was true at a stated past date. Must carry an 'as_of' date. Must never be presented as current.
statusDefinition.PLANNED: Stated as a future intention, plan or expansion. Not operational.
statusDefinition.DISPUTED: Two or more sources conflict and the conflict is unresolved. Must be linked to a CON- record in model/governance/contradictions.json.
statusDefinition.RETIRED: Was in the model and has been shown not to exist, to be a duplicate, or to have ceased. Kept for audit; excluded from all diagrams.

typeDefinition.organization: A legal or quasi-legal body: Maltiti itself, a subsidiary, a partner, a named customer, a named supplier, an NGO, a regulator.
typeDefinition.business_unit: A named internal division, department or operating unit of an organization. Only create when the unit is actually named by a source — do NOT create business units to represent activity areas. Use tags for activity areas.
typeDefinition.location: A geographic place: country, region, district, town, community.
typeDefinition.facility: A built site: processing centre, factory, warehouse, office, retail outlet, laboratory.
typeDefinition.farm: Land under cultivation, whether owned, leased or operated by an out-grower.
typeDefinition.group: An organised or semi-organised collective of people: community group, women's group, picker group, processor group, farmer association.
typeDefinition.person: A named individual. Only record where there is a business reason; treat as personal data (see CLAUDE.md, Data Protection).
typeDefinition.role: A named position or function that people occupy, independent of who holds it.
typeDefinition.material: An input consumed by a process and not sold as-is: raw agricultural inputs, packaging, consumables, utilities.
typeDefinition.product: Anything produced that has, or may have, an onward destination — agricultural output, intermediate good, or finished saleable good.
typeDefinition.process: An activity that transforms, moves, stores, checks or sells. Agricultural, manufacturing, logistical, quality or commercial.
typeDefinition.route: A recurring physical movement path between two points in the network.
typeDefinition.certification: A standard, certification, licence or registration held, sought or required.
typeDefinition.market: A geographic or channel market in which products are sold.
typeDefinition.customer_segment: A class of buyer where no individual buyer is yet known. A NAMED customer is an 'organization' with role 'customer', not a customer_segment.
typeDefinition.equipment: Machinery or plant with material effect on capacity or quality.
typeDefinition.system: An information system, register, record-keeping practice or data store that carries information flows.
typeDefinition.program: A named project, initiative, grant, donor programme or expansion plan.

domains.shea: Shea nut, shea butter and shea-derived value chain.
domains.oils: Essential and vegetable oils other than shea butter.
domains.agriculture: Field crop cultivation and agricultural operations.
domains.community: Community-level sourcing, groups and processing networks.

relationshipDefinition.PART_OF: Structural containment. The subject is a constituent of the object.
relationshipDefinition.OPERATES: Day-to-day operational control, which may differ from ownership.
relationshipDefinition.OPERATES_IN: Has a presence or conducts activity in a place or market.
relationshipDefinition.MEMBER_OF: Membership of a group or organization.
relationshipDefinition.SUPPLIES: Provides a material, product or service to the object.
relationshipDefinition.SOURCES_FROM: Obtains inputs from. Inverse-ish of SUPPLIES; use when the buying side is the documented fact.
relationshipDefinition.PRODUCES: Creates a product or material as output.
relationshipDefinition.CONSUMES: Takes a material or product as input.
relationshipDefinition.INPUT_TO: Material/product flows into a process. The material-flow backbone.
relationshipDefinition.TRANSFORMS_INTO: Direct material transformation between two things in the value chain.
relationshipDefinition.STORED_AT: Warehousing / holding location for a material or product.
relationshipDefinition.TRANSPORTED_VIA: Movement of goods along a route.
relationshipDefinition.SOLD_IN: A product reaches a market or segment.
relationshipDefinition.HOLDS_CERTIFICATION: Subject holds or is covered by a certification.
relationshipDefinition.REQUIRED_BY: A certification or standard is a precondition for a market, customer or product.
relationshipDefinition.QUALITY_CONTROLLED_BY: Subject is subject to a quality process or controlling body.
relationshipDefinition.USES_EQUIPMENT: Process or facility depends on equipment.
relationshipDefinition.INFORMATION_FLOW_TO: Recurring transfer of data, records, orders or specifications.
relationshipDefinition.FINANCIAL_FLOW_TO: Recurring transfer of value: payment, pricing, credit, pre-finance.
relationshipDefinition.PARTICIPATES_IN: Takes part in a programme or initiative.
relationshipDefinition.SAME_AS: Duplicate resolution: the two records denote the same real-world thing. The 'to' entity must be RETIRED and the 'from' entity is canonical.
relationshipDefinition.SUCCEEDS: Subject replaced the object over time.

SRC-0001.title: Maltiti Ecosystem Mapping Project — initial seed brief
SRC-0001.origin: Bilal Abubakari (bilal.abubakari@amalitech.com), project sponsor, via direct instruction to the modelling assistant
limitations: Self-described by its author as incomplete and as a seed only.
Lists activities without stating who performs them, where, at what scale, or whether inside or outside the legal boundary of the company.
Contains no dates for any operational claim, no volumes, no named counterparties, no certifications.
The phrase 'among other activities' means absence from this source is NOT evidence of absence.

SRC-0002.title: Modelling assistant general domain knowledge (shea and agro-processing value chains, Ghanaian geography)
SRC-0002.origin: Claude Opus 5, unverified background knowledge, no citation available
limitations: Cannot be attributed, dated or checked.
May be out of date or simply wrong for Maltiti specifically.
Reflects the general case, not this company.
SRC-0002.usageRule: MAY ONLY support attributes and relationships with status INFERRED. MUST NEVER be the basis for CONFIRMED or PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED. Any claim resting solely on SRC-0002 must have a matching validation question.

GAP-0001.title: Legal identity of Maltiti A. Enterprise Ltd is unrecorded
GAP-0001.description: No registration number, legal form, date of incorporation, registered address, shareholding or directors. The root entity of the whole model is essentially a name.

GAP-0002.title: Internal organisational structure is unknown
GAP-0002.description: SRC-0001 lists activity areas, not named divisions or units. The model deliberately contains ZERO business_unit entities rather than inventing them; activity areas are carried as tags instead. Until real unit names arrive, the Master Enterprise Map cannot show internal structure.

GAP-0003.title: Subsidiaries and related operating units are unnamed
GAP-0003.description: SRC-0001 asserts 'multiple subsidiaries/related operating units' but names none. No subsidiary entities have been created, because creating them would be invention. The count is also unknown.

GAP-0004.title: The boundary of the firm is undefined
GAP-0004.description: For every activity in SRC-0001 it is unknown whether Maltiti performs it itself, through a subsidiary, through a community partner, or buys it as a service. Picking, community processing, soap making, oil extraction, rice milling, farming, logistics and QC are all ambiguous. This single gap degrades the confidence of nearly every relationship in the model.

GAP-0005.title: Number and current status of shea processing centres unverified
GAP-0005.description: 'Approximately 10' is historical and explicitly flagged for validation in SRC-0001. Only three communities are named. It is unknown how many centres operate today, where the other centres are, and whether any have closed.

GAP-0006.title: Region, district and coordinates of the named communities are unknown
GAP-0006.description: Gumo, Malshegu and Katariga have no confirmed administrative placement. The model currently carries an INFERRED 'northern Ghana' placement resting only on SRC-0002.

GAP-0007.title: Head office and principal place of business not identified
GAP-0007.description: No office, headquarters or principal site is recorded. The organisation currently floats above its geography.

GAP-0008.title: No current production volumes or capacities for any product
GAP-0008.description: SRC-0001 refers to historically reported significant shea butter capacity and expansion plans but supplies no figures, and instructs that historical figures must never be treated as current. Every product in the model therefore has zero quantitative grounding.

GAP-0009.title: No certifications recorded at all
GAP-0009.description: Certification is in scope for the model but SRC-0001 names none. It is unknown whether Maltiti holds organic, fair trade, food-safety, cosmetic-regulatory, FDA Ghana, GSA or export certifications, or which its customers require. Zero CERT entities exist — deliberately, rather than guessing plausible ones.

GAP-0010.title: No named customers
GAP-0010.description: Only three abstract segments are known (industrial, retail, institutional). Not one actual buyer is named, so the Market/Customer Map has no instances, only classes.

GAP-0011.title: Export destinations unknown
GAP-0011.description: Export sales are asserted but no destination country, region, buyer, incoterm, port or volume is known. MKT-EXPORT is currently an undifferentiated placeholder.

GAP-0012.title: Community groups are not individually identified
GAP-0012.description: GRP-COMMUNITY-GROUPS, GRP-SHEA-PICKERS, GRP-COMMUNITY-SHEA-PROCESSORS and GRP-SUPPLYING-FARMERS are class placeholders standing for unknown numbers of unnamed real groups. Each must eventually be decomposed into named instances.

GAP-0013.title: Number of pickers, processors and farmers engaged is unknown
GAP-0013.description: No headcount for any community-level actor group. This is usually one of the most quoted figures about a company like this, and the model cannot state it.

GAP-0014.title: Warehousing and storage sites not identified
GAP-0014.description: Storage is asserted as an activity but no warehouse is located, sized or assigned to a product. FAC-WAREHOUSE is a single class placeholder.

GAP-0015.title: Logistics routes and transport arrangements unknown
GAP-0015.description: No route entities exist. How nuts move from community to centre, centre to factory, and factory to market is entirely unmodelled — own fleet, hired transport or buyer collection is unknown.

GAP-0016.title: Quality control practice is a black box
GAP-0016.description: Quality control is asserted as an activity. It is unknown what is tested, where, by whom, against what standard, with what equipment, and what happens on failure. PRC-QUALITY-CONTROL currently has no inputs, no location and no owner.

GAP-0017.title: Packaging inputs, formats and suppliers unknown
GAP-0017.description: Packaging is asserted as an activity. Pack formats, sizes, materials, branding and suppliers are all unknown. MAT-PACKAGING is a class placeholder with no supplier.

GAP-0018.title: Commercial farming has no land, location or tenure
GAP-0018.description: FARM-MALTITI-COMMERCIAL is a single class placeholder. Hectarage, location, tenure, irrigation, mechanisation and whether the land is owned, leased or out-grower managed are all unknown.

GAP-0019.title: Rice processing operations unspecified
GAP-0019.description: 'Rice processing' could mean parboiling, milling, de-stoning, grading, packing, or any combination. No mill, capacity or location is known, and it is unknown whether Maltiti processes its own paddy, third-party paddy, or both.

GAP-0020.title: Oil extraction method and site unknown
GAP-0020.description: Whether the oils are cold-pressed, expeller-pressed, solvent-extracted or bought in and re-packed is unknown, as is where this happens and on what equipment.

GAP-0021.title: 'Other oils' and 'moringa-related agricultural activities' are unresolved catch-alls
GAP-0021.description: SRC-0001 uses both phrases without expansion. PRD-OTHER-OILS and PRD-MORINGA-AGRI are deliberate UNKNOWN placeholders marking named-but-unspecified scope, so that it is visible rather than silently dropped.

GAP-0022.title: Input materials for the oils are inferred, not stated
GAP-0022.description: No source names any input material for the oil products. MAT-MORINGA-SEED, MAT-NEEM-SEED, MAT-BAOBAB-SEED, MAT-PALM-KERNEL and MAT-SHEA-KERNEL all rest on inference alone (ASM-0002, ASM-0003) and may be entirely wrong if Maltiti buys crude oil.

GAP-0023.title: No financial or transactional relationships are modelled
GAP-0023.description: Pricing, payment terms, pre-financing of pickers, credit to customers, and who bears cost at each handover are all unknown. The model has zero FINANCIAL_FLOW_TO relationships even though these were explicitly in scope.

GAP-0024.title: Information flows and systems of record are unmapped
GAP-0024.description: No SYS entities exist. How purchases, weights, quality results, stock and sales are recorded — paper, spreadsheet, ERP — is unknown. This gap directly determines how feasible the eventual Microsoft 365 system is, so it matters more than its priority suggests.

GAP-0025.title: No people, roles or leadership recorded
GAP-0025.description: Zero PER and ROL entities. Ownership, management, and who can authoritatively answer questions about each domain is unknown — which also means the validation backlog has no named respondents.

GAP-0026.title: Expansion plans referenced but unspecified
GAP-0026.description: SRC-0001 mentions historically reported expansion plans without content or date. No PROG entity has been created. It is unknown whether any plan is live, abandoned or completed.

GAP-0027.title: Three provisional processing-centre entities await confirmation or retirement
GAP-0027.description: FAC-PROC-GUMO, FAC-PROC-MALSHEGU and FAC-PROC-KATARIGA were created as provisional placeholders from an ambiguous phrase in SRC-0001 (ASM-0004). Each must be confirmed with a real name and status, merged into a correctly-named centre, or retired. They must not be allowed to harden into apparent fact.

GAP-0028.title: Whether field crops are grown, processed, traded or all three is unclear
GAP-0028.description: Soy, maize, groundnut and rice appear as cultivation activities, but only rice appears as a processing activity. What happens to soy, maize and groundnut after harvest — sold raw, processed elsewhere, used as input — is unknown, so those product entities are dead ends in the material flow.

ASM-0001.statement: Maltiti operates or works through approximately 10 shea processing centres across different communities.
ASM-0001.basis: Stated in SRC-0001 and explicitly flagged there as historical/contextual information requiring current validation.
ASM-0001.impactIfWrong: The scale of the community processing network, and therefore the whole Community Network Map and sourcing capacity picture, is wrong.
ASM-0001.falsifiedBy: A current list of operating processing centres with names, locations and status.

ASM-0002.statement: Shea nuts pass through a kernel stage before butter extraction, so MAT-SHEA-KERNEL is a real intermediate in Maltiti's chain.
ASM-0002.basis: Generic shea value-chain structure (SRC-0002). Not stated by Maltiti.
ASM-0002.impactIfWrong: The intermediate steps of the shea material flow are mis-stated; the Shea Ecosystem Map has a phantom stage.
ASM-0002.falsifiedBy: A description of Maltiti's actual shea processing steps.

ASM-0003.statement: Each named oil is extracted from the correspondingly named plant material (moringa oil from moringa seed, neem oil from neem seed, baobab oil from baobab seed, palm kernel oil from palm kernel, shea oil from shea).
ASM-0003.basis: Product naming plus generic oil-extraction knowledge (SRC-0002). The input materials are not named anywhere in SRC-0001.
ASM-0003.impactIfWrong: The entire inbound side of the essential-oils chain is fictional. Maltiti may buy crude oil and only refine or blend it.
ASM-0003.falsifiedBy: Confirmation of what is actually purchased: seed, crude oil, or finished oil for re-packing.

ASM-0004.statement: Gumo, Malshegu and Katariga each host a shea processing centre that Maltiti operates or sources from.
ASM-0004.basis: SRC-0001 lists them under 'Known community/processing locations'. The wording conflates community and processing site; it does not confirm a centre at each.
ASM-0004.impactIfWrong: Three provisional facility entities are fictional and must be retired; the community map collapses to bare locations.
ASM-0004.falsifiedBy: Site-by-site confirmation of what exists in each community.

ASM-0005.statement: Gumo, Malshegu and Katariga are communities in northern Ghana, within the shea belt.
ASM-0005.basis: Assistant background knowledge of Ghanaian place names (SRC-0002) plus the shea-centric activity profile. No source states the region or district.
ASM-0005.impactIfWrong: The Geographic Map is wrong and any logistics reasoning built on it is wrong.
ASM-0005.falsifiedBy: Region and district for each community, or GPS coordinates.

ASM-0006.statement: Maltiti sells finished products under its own account, rather than acting solely as a toll processor for other brands.
ASM-0006.basis: SRC-0001 lists domestic sales, export sales and three customer types alongside its own product lines.
ASM-0006.impactIfWrong: The Market/Customer Map inverts: Maltiti would be a supplier inside someone else's chain rather than the chain owner.
ASM-0006.falsifiedBy: Revenue split by own-brand versus contract manufacturing.

ASM-0007.statement: Community pickers and community shea processors are suppliers to Maltiti, not employees of Maltiti.
ASM-0007.basis: SRC-0001 describes 'community-based' sourcing and processing networks and lists pickers and processors as distinct ecosystem actors.
ASM-0007.impactIfWrong: Headcount, cost structure, labour obligations and the legal boundary of the firm are all mis-drawn.
ASM-0007.falsifiedBy: The contractual basis of the relationship with pickers and community processors.

ASM-0008.statement: Soap and cosmetics manufacturing consumes shea butter produced upstream within the same group, rather than bought-in butter.
ASM-0008.basis: Product naming ('shea soap', 'shea butter powdered soap', 'shea-based cosmetics') alongside in-house shea butter processing in SRC-0001.
ASM-0008.impactIfWrong: The internal material flow linking upstream shea to downstream manufacturing is fictional; they may be independent chains.
ASM-0008.falsifiedBy: Whether the soap plant draws butter internally or purchases it.

ASM-0009.statement: The activity list in SRC-0001 is not exhaustive, so absence of an activity from the model is not evidence that Maltiti does not do it.
ASM-0009.basis: SRC-0001 states the company is involved in a broad ecosystem 'including, among other activities'.
ASM-0009.impactIfWrong: None — this assumption makes the model more cautious, not less.
ASM-0009.falsifiedBy: A statement that the activity list is complete.

ASM-0010.statement: Soy, maize, groundnut and rice cultivation are carried out by Maltiti or an affiliated unit, rather than merely being crops Maltiti buys from third parties.
ASM-0010.basis: SRC-0001 lists them under 'commercial farming' and as distinct '<crop> cultivation' activities.
ASM-0010.impactIfWrong: The Agriculture Map shows owned production where in fact there is only procurement.
ASM-0010.falsifiedBy: Land holdings, hectarage and tenure for each crop, or confirmation that crops are bought in.

VQ-0001.question: How many shea processing centres are operating today, in which communities, and are any of the historical ~10 now closed or dormant?
VQ-0001.whyItMatters: The entire community network and sourcing capacity picture rests on a historical figure the sponsor has already flagged as unvalidated.

VQ-0002.question: Is there a processing centre at each of Gumo, Malshegu and Katariga, and what is each one actually called?
VQ-0002.whyItMatters: Three entities in the model are provisional placeholders derived from an ambiguous phrase. They must be confirmed, renamed or deleted before anyone treats them as real.

VQ-0004.question: For each activity — picking, community processing, butter processing, soap making, cosmetics, oil extraction, rice processing, farming, packaging, storage, QC, logistics — does Maltiti do it itself, through a subsidiary, through a community partner, or buy it as a service?
VQ-0004.whyItMatters: This is the highest-leverage question in the backlog. It sets the legal boundary of the firm and fixes the ownership of nearly every relationship in the model at once.

VQ-0005.question: What are the names of the subsidiaries and related operating units, and how is each related to Maltiti A. Enterprise Ltd?
VQ-0005.whyItMatters: The model asserts they exist but names none, so the corporate layer of the Executive and Master maps is currently empty.

VQ-0008.question: What is current annual production or throughput for shea butter, soap, each oil, and rice — and for what period?
VQ-0008.whyItMatters: The model has no quantitative grounding at all, and has been explicitly instructed not to reuse historical capacity claims as current.

VQ-0009.question: Who are the actual customers? Name the largest buyers in each of the industrial, retail and institutional segments.
VQ-0009.whyItMatters: The Market/Customer Map currently contains only abstract segments and not a single real buyer.

VQ-0011.question: Which certifications does Maltiti hold, which has it applied for, and which do its customers or export markets require?
VQ-0011.whyItMatters: Certification is in scope, entirely unpopulated, and usually the gating factor for export and industrial sales.

VQ-0014.question: What is the registered legal identity of Maltiti A. Enterprise Ltd — registration number, legal form, incorporation date, registered address, directors and shareholders?
VQ-0014.whyItMatters: The root entity of the model is currently little more than a name, and every ownership relationship hangs off it.

VQ-0015.question: Where is the head office and the principal place of business, and what other permanent sites exist (factory, warehouse, offices, outlets)?
VQ-0015.whyItMatters: The organisation currently has no anchor in geography, so no Geographic Map can be built.

VQ-0020.question: What quality control actually happens — what is tested, at which points, by whom, against which standard, with what equipment, and what happens when a batch fails?
VQ-0020.whyItMatters: QC is asserted as an activity but is a complete black box; it also determines credibility with industrial and export buyers.

VQ-0003.question: Which region and district are Gumo, Malshegu and Katariga in, and roughly how far is each from the main processing site?
VQ-0003.whyItMatters: The model's only geographic placement is an inference from unverifiable background knowledge (ASM-0005).

VQ-0006.question: What are the actual steps from picked shea nut to finished butter, and which of them happen in the community versus at a central site?
VQ-0006.whyItMatters: The kernel stage in the model is inferred from generic value-chain knowledge, not from Maltiti.

VQ-0007.question: What is the contractual relationship with pickers and community processors — employees, contracted suppliers, members of a cooperative, or informal sellers?
VQ-0007.whyItMatters: Determines whether thousands of community actors sit inside or outside the firm, which changes headcount, cost base and obligations.

VQ-0010.question: For commercial farming: how much land, where, under what tenure, and which crops on it — and is the produce sold raw or used as input to Maltiti's own processing?
VQ-0010.whyItMatters: The agriculture side is a single class placeholder with no land, location or destination for its output.

VQ-0012.question: For moringa, neem, baobab, palm kernel and shea oil: does Maltiti buy seed and extract the oil itself, or buy crude oil and refine or re-pack it? What extraction method and equipment is used?
VQ-0012.whyItMatters: The whole inbound side of the oils chain is inferred from product names alone and could be entirely fictional.

VQ-0013.question: Does soap and cosmetics manufacturing use shea butter produced by Maltiti's own upstream operations, or bought-in butter?
VQ-0013.whyItMatters: Decides whether upstream shea and downstream manufacturing are one integrated chain or two independent businesses.

VQ-0016.question: Which countries does Maltiti export to, through which buyers or agents, and on what terms?
VQ-0016.whyItMatters: Export is asserted but entirely undifferentiated — a single placeholder market with no destination.

VQ-0017.question: How many pickers, community processors and supplying farmers does Maltiti work with, and are they organised into named groups or cooperatives?
VQ-0017.whyItMatters: Four class placeholders in the model stand for an unknown number of unnamed real groups; this is also the figure most often quoted externally about companies of this type.

VQ-0018.question: Where is product and raw material stored, at what capacity, and who controls stock?
VQ-0018.whyItMatters: Storage is asserted but unlocated and unsized; warehousing is a single class placeholder.

VQ-0022.question: What does 'rice processing' consist of — parboiling, milling, de-stoning, grading, packing — where does it happen, and is the paddy Maltiti's own or bought in?
VQ-0022.whyItMatters: A whole product line is represented by one undifferentiated process with no site and no confirmed input.

VQ-0024.question: How are pickers and community processors paid — cash on delivery, per weight, pre-financed, or through a group — and what payment terms apply to customers?
VQ-0024.whyItMatters: Financial and transactional relationships were explicitly in scope and the model currently contains none.

VQ-0025.question: How are purchases, weights, quality results, stock and sales currently recorded — paper books, spreadsheets, an accounting package, or a traceability system? Who maintains them?
VQ-0025.whyItMatters: Determines what information flows can be mapped, and directly determines how realistic the eventual Microsoft 365 system is. This question is worth more than its P2 rank suggests.

VQ-0028.question: What happens to the soy, maize and groundnut after harvest — sold raw, processed by Maltiti, or used as input elsewhere?
VQ-0028.whyItMatters: Three product entities are currently dead ends with no onward flow, leaving the Agriculture Map disconnected from the rest of the model.

VQ-0019.question: How do goods physically move — community to centre, centre to factory, factory to customer? Own vehicles, hired transport, or buyer collection?
VQ-0019.whyItMatters: No logistics routes exist in the model at all.

VQ-0021.question: What pack formats and sizes exist per product, what packaging materials are used, and who supplies them?
VQ-0021.whyItMatters: Packaging is asserted as an activity but the model holds a single class placeholder with no supplier and no formats.

VQ-0023.question: What is covered by 'other oils' and by 'moringa-related agricultural activities'?
VQ-0023.whyItMatters: Two placeholders mark scope that was named but never specified; leaving them unexpanded keeps a known unknown visible.

VQ-0026.question: Who leads each area of the business, and who is the right person to answer questions about shea, agriculture, manufacturing, quality and sales?
VQ-0026.whyItMatters: The backlog currently addresses questions to job titles that may not exist. Named respondents make every future batch faster.

VQ-0027.question: Which expansion plans are currently live, which have been completed, and which were abandoned?
VQ-0027.whyItMatters: Historical expansion claims must not be allowed to leak into the model as current capability.

views.title: Executive Ecosystem Map
views.description: The one-screen answer to "what is Maltiti?": who supplies it, what it does, what it makes, and who buys. Deliberately curated and deliberately incomplete — it must stay readable. Individual oils, individual crops, storage, packaging and quality control are all omitted here and appear on the domain maps instead. This is not a summary of everything known; it is a briefing aid.

views.title: Master Enterprise Map
views.description: Everything in the model. Expected to be large and hard to read — that is its job. Use it to check coverage and connectivity, not to brief anyone.

views.title: Shea Ecosystem Map
views.description: The shea value chain end to end: picking, community processing, butter production, and the shea-derived products.

views.title: Community Network Map
views.description: Communities, community groups, pickers, processors and the community-level processing sites. Currently the least instantiated part of the model: almost every node here is a class or a placeholder.

views.title: Agriculture Map
views.description: Commercial farming, crops, cultivation and the destination of harvested output.

views.title: Manufacturing Map
views.description: Factory-based transformation: soap, cosmetics, butter processing, rice processing, packaging and the quality controls over them.

views.title: Essential Oils Map
views.description: The oils chain: presumed seed inputs, extraction, and the oil products. Almost the entire inbound side of this map is inferred from product names and may be wrong.

views.title: Product Map
views.description: Every product and product family, and the process that makes each one. No volumes, specifications or pack formats are known for any of them.

views.title: Supply Chain Map
views.description: Material flow from source to market: who supplies what, what is consumed by which process, what is stored where, and what moves to market. Logistics routes are entirely absent because none are known.

views.title: Market and Customer Map
views.description: Markets, customer segments and the products reaching them. Contains no named customer, because none is known.

views.title: Geographic Map
views.description: Where things physically are. Currently near-empty: no site has a confirmed address or coordinate, and the only regional placement in the model is an inference.
